$description: The words on the demo's card and its status panels, one set per language, keyed by language code. English is the full set, and npm run check fails a language that is missing a string English has. A list, such as the features, has one string per item. No string writes a digit: the price and the trial length are data in demo/demo.js, formatted for each panel's language, and {days} marks where the trial length goes. npm run check fails a string with a digit in it.
